hosts.name: FFmpeg lut3d
hosts.range: Full-range RGB48 throughout; no YUV or limited-range conversion.
hosts.notes: Verified by scripts/verify-lut-hosts.mjs against the exact downloaded .cube artifacts.

hosts.name: DaVinci Resolve
hosts.importRoute: Copy the .cube into the LUT folder, then apply it on a node or in the timeline colour management settings.
hosts.blocker: No DaVinci Resolve installation is available to this project. Applying and reading back a graded frame requires a licensed desktop host on macOS or Windows.

hosts.name: Adobe Photoshop
hosts.importRoute: Colour Lookup adjustment layer, 3DLUT File → Load 3D LUT.
hosts.blocker: No Adobe Photoshop installation is available to this project. Photoshop applies LUTs in its own document working space, so the profile and range settings must be recorded from a real session.

hosts.name: Adobe Lightroom
hosts.importRoute: Lightroom Classic imports .cube files only as camera or creative profiles built with the Adobe Profile Editor; there is no direct .cube import in the Develop module.
hosts.blocker: No Adobe Lightroom installation or Profile Editor build is available to this project. The profile-wrapping workflow must be performed and recorded by a human on a licensed host.
